evidence.note: User's hand engages the flat lounge-chair backrest near its end.
Backrest is clearly raised upright with the pillow attached.
Backrest remains upright immediately before the lowering action.
User grips the raised section and begins lowering it.
The chair surface is flat again.

events.object_description: Adjustable backrest of the white balcony lounge chair

evidence.note: Main grill lid is closed.
User lifts the main lid by its handle.
Main lid is fully open, exposing the cooking grates.
User grips the open lid to lower it.
Main lid is fully closed.

events.object_description: Main cooking lid of the stainless-steel gas grill

evidence.note: Grill's lower cabinet door is closed.
User swings the lower cabinet door outward.
Door is open and the propane cylinder is visible.
Cabinet door remains fully open.
User closes the cabinet door.
Lower cabinet is closed again.

events.object_description: Lower propane-compartment door of the gas grill

evidence.note: Door-facing folding shelf appears stowed beside the grill.
User reaches to and manipulates the shelf assembly.
Dark metal shelf is extended horizontally.
Shelf remains extended.
Shelf is seen edge-on during the apparent folding action.
Black underside/panel appears folded down beside the grill.

events.object_description: Door-facing folding side shelf of the gas grill

evidence.note: Trellis-facing red-labeled side platform is viewed near its stowed position, though perspective is ambiguous.
User reaches under and manipulates the red-labeled side platform.
Side platform is visibly extended horizontally.
Red-labeled platform remains extended.
Platform is being folded or has just moved out of its extended position.
Platform is no longer horizontally extended.

events.object_description: Trellis-facing red-labeled folding side-burner shelf of the gas grill

notes: Five distinct state-change episodes are visible. The two folding-shelf episodes are less certain because strong camera roll and edge-on views make their folded versus extended states difficult to distinguish.
scene_description: A balcony containing a white adjustable lounge chair and a stainless-steel gas grill. The user first raises and lowers the chair backrest, then manipulates the grill's main lid, lower propane cabinet, and two separate folding side shelves.
